title: Working Hours Policy
description: Employees must follow the official working hours of the company.

title: Attendance Policy
description: Employees must attend work on time and follow the company's attendance rules.

title: Leave Policy
description: Employees can submit leave requests through the HR Management System.

title: Code of Conduct
description: Employees must maintain professional and respectful behavior in the workplace.

title: Data Privacy Policy
description: Employee and company information must be kept confidential and protected.

title: IT Security Policy
description: Company systems and devices must be used responsibly and securely.

title: Remote Work Policy
description: Remote work is allowed only with prior approval from the HR department.

title: Overtime Policy
description: Overtime work must be approved by the responsible manager.
